name: Shokushu de Tsukurou! Dosukebe Otokonoko - Ikiri Yankee vs Shokushu Yashiki
original_name: 触手で作ろう!ドスケベ男の娘 イキリヤンキーvs触手屋敷
source:
Kotarou, a famous local delinquent, is asked by his younger brother Yasutaka to confront a mysterious old man.

However, due to Yasutaka's betrayal, he is captured in a tentacle mansion. 

Will Kotarou be able to escape from the mansion full of monsters without becoming a bitch!?​

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01203755.html]DLsite[/url]]
